name: agy-proof-min
goal: Prove that Tractor can route a real workspace task through agy to Gemini

nodes.prompt: Create a file named proof.txt in the workspace root containing exactly one line: AGY_PROOF_OK (a single trailing newline, no other content).

nodes.tool_command: test "$(cat proof.txt)" = AGY_PROOF_OK && test "$(wc -l < proof.txt | tr -d ' ')" = 1
